Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap from my side: we covered high-level goals (reduce per-request latency for inference, bring down hosting costs via batching + quantization, and enable a predictable rollout path for model updates). You mentioned the internal ML team evaluates latency-sensitive inference and the infra team will want to validate network/isolation requirements.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra leads so we can walk architecture, model sizing, and integration options (Private/Dedicated/Hosted tradeoffs). Proposed time windows next week:
- Tue 2026-03-31 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 2026-04-01 11:00–12:30 PT
- Thu 2026-04-02 13:00–14:30 PT

Suggested agenda (rough):
1) 10–15m: Introductions & goals
2) 20–30m: Current model architecture, runtime characteristics, and SLOs (Priya / ML)
3) 20–30m: Infra constraints, VPC, network egress, and data controls (Infra lead)
4) 15–20m: Recommended Redwood deployment patterns and cost/latency tradeoffs
5) 10–15m: Action items & follow-ups (rollout plan, eval set)

Can you confirm which of the windows work and who from your side should be invited (ML lead + infra/ops lead)? I can send a calendar invite and share an agenda PDF / prep doc.

Attachments: acme-tech-deep-dive.ics (proposed invite stub)

Thanks — looking forward to it.
